coverage.description: Federal crop insurance Summary of Business by commodity year, state, county, crop, insurance plan, coverage category, delivery type and coverage level: policies, units, insured quantity, liability, total premium, premium subsidy, indemnity and loss ratio, dollars (RMA, 1989 on; updated weekly for open years).

year.desc: commodity year, 1989 on (the current and next years are partial)

state.desc: keep these states (USPS abbreviation or 2-digit FIPS code; a list works)

county.desc: keep these 3-digit county FIPS codes (999 is All Other Counties)

commodity.desc: keep these commodities (name as published, e.g. Corn, Soybeans, or the 4-digit RMA code; case-insensitive)

plan.desc: keep these insurance plans (abbreviation, e.g. RP, YP, RPHPE, APH, or the plan code)

coverage_category.desc: keep A (buy-up), C (CAT), E (existing coverage policy) or L (limited)

delivery_type.desc: keep RBUP, RCAT (reinsured, sold by companies), FBUP or FCAT (federal)

reinsurance.description: Standard Reinsurance Agreement results by reinsurance year and fund (A assigned, C commercial), national or by state: gross liability, premium and indemnity, and the companies' retained liability, premium, indemnity and net underwriting gain or loss, dollars (RMA, 2014 on).

year.desc: reinsurance year, 2014 on (the latest is not final)

level.desc: National (totals by fund) or State (each state by fund)

state.desc: keep these states (USPS abbreviation) in the State report
